transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm... well, I'm here because of my house. Everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just, you know, paperwork and missed payments. But... I know better. The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job, they've been... quietly working together to push me out. They keep showing me all these papers, but... it doesn't change what I've been seeing for almost two years now.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No. I don't... I don't hear voices. Just the people who are actually there.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I sleep fine. I haven't had anything like that.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No. I mean... I guess I've been stressed, obviously, with everything they're doing with the house. But... no, not depressed.
Besides people trying to force you out of your house, have you noticed anything else that others say isn't real?
No. I don't... I don't know what you mean by that. It's just what I already told you about the house. Nothing else.
Has anyone told you that your speech or behavior has seemed disorganized or hard to follow?
No. I... people understand me fine. No one has ever said that to me.
How long have you believed that the bank and people at work are working together to force you out of your house?
Um... about a year and nine months, I guess. That's... that's when the foreclosure notices started showing up. And all the bank calls just... taking over our home life. It's been going on since then.
If someone showed you clear proof that the foreclosure was only due to missed payments and not a plan against you, would you believe them?

No. I... I wouldn't. I'm only here because everyone keeps acting like it's just paperwork and missed payments. But I know what's happening. The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job. They're working together to push me out. No amount of papers they show me is going to change what I've been seeing for almost two years.
Have you noticed yourself becoming much less interested in seeing friends or doing things you used to enjoy?
No. I mean... I still do things. I still see people when I can. I just have a lot to deal with right now, so... I'm busy. But no.
